name: LustyVerse: Passion on Display
source:
Ahh, college. The good old days.
Without the stress of exams, it can truly be an amazing experience.
Especially if a hot new girl moves in right next door.
So what are you gonna do?
Will you enjoy the front view seat to her room, from the shadows of your own?
Or, will you take a chance and try and get some?
Play, and find out! But watch out...
A handsome, young man as yourself might get over his head, if you're not careful enough.​
